    max_val = max(a)
    min_index = a.index(min_val)
    max_index = a.index(max_val)

    max_distance = initial_distance
    for i in range(n):

            new_distance = abs(i - max_index)
            if new_distance > max_distance:
                max_distance = new_distance
    
    # Try swapping the maximum value with every other value
    for i in range(n):
        if i != max_index:
            new_distance = abs(min_index - i)
            if new_distance > max_distance:
                max_distance = new_distance
    
    return max_distance

    max_index = a.index(n)

        a[min_index], a[min_index - 1] = a[min_index - 1], a[min_index]
        new_min_index = a.index(1)
        new_max_index = a.index(n)
        swapped_distance = abs(new_min_index - new_max_index)
        a[min_index], a[min_index - 1] = a[min_index - 1], a[min_index]  # Revert the swap
        
        return max(initial_distance, swapped_distance)
    else:
        return initial_distance
